title: Naturality of the normalized underived native tensor comparison
statement: The normalized pointwise underived comparisons assemble into a bifunctor natural isomorphism whose component at (P,Q) is exactly U.underived P Q.

source.place: Native tensor model, uniqueness of the tensor-Hom mate and naturality in both variables; Stacks 06YS and 06YU

proof.text: Apply U.uncurry to the native adjunct of any map f:T(P,Q) to I. Cancel the adjunction equivalence and identify the ringed adjunction with SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv. This expresses U.underived(P,Q).inv followed by native(f) as the braiding followed by the inverse ringed adjunct of native(adjunct(f)) followed by nativeHom. Specialize f to the identity to express each inverse component.

For p:P to Pprime and q:Q to Qprime, apply this formula to T.map(p).app(Q) followed by T(Pprime).map(q). Mathlib ParametrizedAdjunction.homEquiv_naturality_one and homEquiv_naturality_two express its native adjunct as q followed by the identity adjunct followed by ihom.map(p.op). Naturality of b.nativeHom replaces the last map by homObjMap(native(p),id). Cancel the braiding and apply injectivity of tensorHomEquiv; its whiskerRight and whiskerLeft naturality identities give precisely the tensor of native(q) and native(p) followed by the target inverse component. Braiding naturality supplies the reversed factor order.

The preceding equality is the naturality of the inverse pointwise isomorphisms. Assemble these with NatIso.ofComponents and invert, obtaining the required natural isomorphism. Its forward components are definitionally the prescribed U.underived homs.
